# meshes.concepts: IPolygonMesh3D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Anything whose natural explicit form is a polygon mesh rather than a triangle
> mesh: the typed solids, whose faces are the polygons of their construction.
> The triangle mesh follows by fan triangulation, so ToPolygonMesh is the only
> obligation and ToTriangleMesh arrives derived.

## Signature

```plato
interface IPolygonMesh3D
    inherits IMesh3D
```
